name: io.github.avansledright/gridiron-data
title: GridIron Data
description: NFL fantasy football data: players, projections, stats, snaps, news, injuries and prop odds.

tools.name: list_players
tools.description: Returns a page of NFL players (player_id, name, position, team), optionally for one position, paged with next_cursor. Use it to browse a position group; to find a specific player, search_players is faster. Free plan.

position.title: Position
position.description: Only this position. Pro keys can also list offensive linemen with C, G or OT.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Finds players by full or partial name (case-insensitive) and returns each match's exact player_id ("First Last#POS"), team and position. Use it first whenever you have a name but not the id the other tools need. Defenses match by team code or nickname too ("TB", "Bucs", "Tampa Bay DST"). Free plan.

name.title: Name
name.description: Full or partial player name, case-insensitive. For a defense, a team code or nickname works ("TB", "Bucs", "Tampa Bay DST").

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Returns one player's profile by id: name, team, position, injury status, jersey and cross-system ids, plus per-season data on Basic and above. Use it to check a player's current team or injury status. Free plan (profile fields only; season data needs Basic).

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

season.title: Season
season.description: Only include this season's data. Default: every season.

tools.name: get_player_career
tools.description: Returns a player's career profile for dynasty questions: draft year, round, pick and team, college, age, years in the league, plus his fantasy points season by season (2020 on) and career totals in the chosen scoring. Use it for "how old is he?", "where was he drafted?" and "how has he trended year to year?". Basic plan and above.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.

tools.name: get_projections
tools.description: Returns projected fantasy points for every player in an NFL week (1-18), in PPR, half-PPR or standard scoring, optionally for one position or team. Use it for start/sit, rankings and "top N at a position this week". Each row also has gridiron_projection, GridIron Data's own model (with model_version and as_of; null when none), which unlike projected_points may be displayed under Pro + Commercial. Players who can't play project 0 with available=false. Free plan: the current week of the current season; other weeks and seasons need Basic; Pro adds projected_stats per row (pass_yds, rec, rush_yds, ...).

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.

season.title: Season
season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.

weekly_only.title: Weekly Only
weekly_only.description: true = only real weekly projections, without the season-prorated fallback used for weeks not yet published.

team.title: Team
team.description: Only this team's players. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

gridiron_only.title: Gridiron Only
gridiron_only.description: true = only GridIron Data's own model projections (gridiron_projection).

tools.name: get_player_by_espn_id
tools.description: Returns the player whose ESPN athlete id this is (the numeric id ESPN and many sportsbook feeds use), as the same record get_player returns. Use it to join ESPN or sportsbook data to GridIron player ids. Free plan.

tools.name: get_prop_probability
tools.description: Returns the probability a player goes over or under a stat line (passing, rushing or receiving yards, TDs, attempts, completions, interceptions, receptions), with fair no-vig American odds for each side, the projected mean and spread, the week's game and betting line, and the model's backtest. Use it to price a player prop or compare a sportsbook line with a fair price. Players on bye or OUT/IR get p_over 0. Model estimate, not betting advice. Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

stat.title: Stat
stat.description: The stat the line is on.

line.title: Line
line.description: The line to price, or up to 10 comma-separated lines.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: The player (give this or espn_id). GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

espn_id.title: Espn Id
espn_id.description: ESPN athlete id, instead of player_id.

week.title: Week
week.description: NFL week, 1-18. Default: the current week, or the next one if the player's game this week is already final.

tools.name: get_defense_vs_position
tools.description: Returns what each NFL defense allows per game to QBs, RBs, WRs or TEs: fantasy points plus yards, TDs, receptions and targets, from ESPN box scores, ranked so rank 1 allows the most (the best matchup). Use it for matchup-based start/sit and streaming, optionally over the last N weeks. Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

position.title: Position
position.description: QB, RB, WR or TE. Default: all four.

last.title: Last
last.description: Only the trailing N weeks with games, 1-18. Default: the whole season.

team.title: Team
team.description: Only this defense. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: Returns a player's actual stats for one season (2020 to now): fantasy points week by week and in total in the chosen scoring, plus the raw stat line and snap share each week. Use it for "how did X do" questions, game logs and comparisons with projections. Basic plan and above.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.

tools.name: get_deviations
tools.description: Returns how a player's actual fantasy points compared with his projections: the average deviation and each week's projected vs actual. Use it to judge boom/bust tendencies or whether a player keeps beating (or missing) his projection. Basic plan and above.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

season.title: Season
season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.

tools.name: get_snap_share
tools.description: Returns a player's offensive snap share each week (the % of his team's offensive plays he was on the field for), the season average, and a trailing average with its change vs the season. Use it to spot role changes before they show in the box score (a committee back taking over, a rookie WR passing a veteran). Seasons 2020-2026, current season updated weekly. Basic plan and above.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

season.title: Season
season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.

trend.title: Trend
trend.description: Weeks in the trailing average compared with the season, 1-18.

tools.name: get_matchups
tools.description: Returns a player's past games and fantasy points against one opponent. Use it for matchup questions like "how does he do against KC?". Basic plan and above.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

opponent.title: Opponent
opponent.description: Opponent team code, e.g. KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

tools.name: get_player_news
tools.description: Returns recent news headlines for one player, newest first, each tagged by impact (injury, role, transaction or general). Use it for "any news on X?" and injury or role questions about a specific player; for the whole league use get_latest_news. Basic plan and above.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: Only headlines with this impact tag.

tools.name: request_news_scrape
tools.description: Queues an on-demand news pull for a player who has no news coverage yet and returns at once (202); the headlines appear in get_player_news shortly after. Use it only when get_player_news comes back empty. Asking twice is harmless. Basic plan and above.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

tools.name: get_latest_news
tools.description: Returns the league-wide NFL news feed across every tracked player, newest first: signings, trades, cuts, injuries and depth-chart moves, filterable by time, impact, position and team, paged with next_cursor. Use it for "what happened today/this week" or a team's or position's latest news. Basic plan and above.

since.title: Since
since.description: Only news after this time: ISO-8601 or unix seconds. Default: the last `days` days. Clamped to 90 days.

days.title: Days
days.description: Lookback when since is omitted, 1-90. Default 7.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: Impact tags, comma-separated: injury, transaction, role, general.

position.title: Position
position.description: Positions, comma-separated (QB, RB, WR, TE, K, DST).

team.title: Team
team.description: Only this team's players. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

tools.name: get_ros_projections
tools.description: Returns each player's projected fantasy points for the rest of the current season (weeks already played and his bye are skipped), with games_remaining and points_per_game. Use it for trades, waiver pickups and dynasty or keeper decisions. Filter by position, team or one player. Basic plan and above.

team.title: Team
team.description: Only this team's players. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: Only this player. GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Returns the NFL regular-season schedule: week, home and away teams, kickoff time (UTC), status and final score, for a season, one week or one team (with that team's bye week). Use it for "who plays whom", kickoff times and results. Basic plan and above; Pro keys also get each game's betting line (spread_home, over_under, moneylines, implied team points).

season.title: Season
season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.

week.title: Week
week.description: Only this week, 1-18. Default: the whole season.

team.title: Team
team.description: Only this team's games (also returns its bye week). Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

tools.name: get_byes
tools.description: Returns every team's bye week for a season, and the teams on bye each week. Use it to plan lineups and spot bye-week holes on a roster. Basic plan and above.

season.title: Season
season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.

tools.name: get_injury_changes
tools.description: Returns players whose injury status changed since a time (default the last 24 hours, up to 14 days back), with previous_status, status and detected_at. Statuses are checked against ESPN every 2 minutes from 8am to 1am ET. Use it for "who got hurt or cleared today?" and game-day checks; pass next_since back as since to get only newer changes. Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

since.title: Since
since.description: Only changes after this time: ISO-8601 or unix seconds. Default: 24 hours ago; at most 14 days back. Pass a previous answer's next_since to get only newer changes.

team.title: Team
team.description: Only this team. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

tools.name: get_player_by_gsis_id
tools.description: Returns the player with this NFL GSIS id (e.g. "00-0034857", the key nflverse and NFL data use), as the same record get_player returns, with an ids map (gsis, pfr, pff, nfl, espn, sleeper) from the daily nflverse crosswalk. Use it to join nflverse or NFL data to GridIron. Free plan.

gsis_id.title: Gsis Id
gsis_id.description: NFL GSIS id, the key nflverse and NFL data use.

tools.name: get_depth_chart
tools.description: Returns NFL depth charts as of the daily nflverse refresh (as_of), for one team or all 32, optionally one position or group (CB, LB, EDGE, ...) or starters only. Each entry has the player, ids, position, formation, slot, depth within the slot (1 = starter), a starter flag, and the player's current injury_status and available, so an OUT or IR starter is flagged rather than moved. Use it for "who are the Bears' starting WRs?" or the next man up behind an injured player. Built from ESPN's public depth charts via nflverse, not official team depth charts. Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

team.title: Team
team.description: Only this team. Default: all 32. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

position.title: Position
position.description: Depth chart position, e.g. QB, RB, WR, TE, LT, C, PK, LCB, WLB. Groups also work: K, OT, G, OL, and on defense DE, DT, DL, EDGE, LB, CB, S, DB.

starters.title: Starters
starters.description: true = starters only: the first player in each slot (depth 1), e.g. three WRs per team in the base offense. With position=QB, every team's starting QB.

tools.name: get_inactives
tools.description: Returns the NFL's official game-day inactives for a week (default the newest week published), by team, with gsis, espn, sleeper and pfr ids. Published after the games, usually days later. Use it for audits and backtesting, not as a pre-kickoff list (teams_published vs teams_played shows how complete the week is). Pro plan (Free and Basic keys get 403 pro_required).

week.title: Week
week.description: Week 1-22 (19+ are playoffs). Default: the newest week with inactives published.

team.title: Team
team.description: Only this team. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

season.title: Season
season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.

tools.name: get_coverage_splits
tools.description: Returns how a receiver does against man vs zone coverage and against each coverage shell (Cover 1, 2, 3, 4, ...): targets, catch rate, yards and EPA per target, and his share of targets in each. Coverage splits are the 2025 season (nflverse has no 2026 coverage file yet). It also returns 2026 season-to-date splits against the blitz and on play action, contested catch rate and drops (FTN charting via nflverse). Splits under 15 targets are flagged small_sample. Use it for "how does he do against man vs zone?". Players with at least 10 targets. No slot/wide alignment data. Basic plan and above.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

tools.name: get_defense_coverage
tools.description: Returns what coverage a defense plays: its man vs zone rate, coverage shell mix, blitz and pressure rate, and what it allowed against man and zone, from the 2025 season (nflverse has no 2026 coverage file yet), plus its 2026 season-to-date blitz rate, average pass rushers and box count (FTN charting via nflverse). Use it for "does this defense play man or zone?" and "how often does it blitz?". Basic plan and above.

team.title: Team
team.description: Defense team code. Team code, e.g. BUF or KC. LA/LAR, WSH/WAS and JAC/JAX are interchangeable.

tools.name: get_coverage_matchup
tools.description: Returns a receiver's man vs zone splits (2025 season) and blitz splits (2026 season to date) next to this week's opponent's coverage tendencies (man/zone mix, shells, what it allows) and 2026 blitz rate, with a one-line plain read. Use it for "how does he match up with the coverage he will see Sunday?". Splits under 15 targets are flagged small_sample. No slot/wide alignment data. Basic plan and above.

player_id.title: Player Id
player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.

week.title: Week
week.description: NFL regular-season week, 1-18. Default: the current week.
